# Primerica Announces $500 Million Share Repurchase Program for 2027


November 23, 2026 4:15pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_fe741ea0dd86966be3caa1c1efaa8f5e/primerica/news/2026-11-23_Primerica_Announces_500_Million_Share_Repurchase_390.pdf)


DULUTH, Ga.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Primerica, Inc. (NYSE: PRI) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a $500 million share repurchase program to occur through December 31, 2027. Share repurchases may be made from time to time through open market transactions, block trades and/or privately negotiated transactions and are subject to market conditions, as well as corporate, regulatory, and other considerations.


“The combination of our strong capital position and cash generation capability provides us with substantial financial flexibility,” said Glenn Williams, Chief Executive Officer of Primerica. “This share repurchase authorization reflects the confidence we have in the durability of our business model, our ability to generate excess capital and our commitment to delivering long-term value to stockholders."


This share repurchase program may be discontinued at any time by the Board of Directors, and the Company has no obligation to repurchase any amount of its common stock under the program. The Company intends to make all repurchases in compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and to administer the plan in accordance with applicable laws, including Rule 10b-18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.


**About Primerica, Inc.**


Primerica, Inc. is a leading diversified financial services distribution company serving middle-income households in the United States and Canada. Our licensed representatives educate families on how to prepare for a more secure financial future and help them achieve their financial goals with our term life insurance and third-party mutual funds, managed accounts, annuities, loans and other financial products. We insured over 5.5 million lives and had approximately 3.1 million client investment accounts as of December 31, 2025. Through our life insurance subsidiaries in North America, in 2025 Primerica was the #3 issuer of term life insurance, which we largely reinsure. Primerica stock is included in the S&P MidCap 400 and the Russell 1000 stock indices and is traded on The New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “PRI”. We are headquartered in Duluth, Georgia.
